notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.
